C-EVENT-TEMPLATES-375.IntentSummary: Extend existing monthly composition through versioned structured event templates and a bounded selection preview. One owner per data, selection and UI scope; root owns DOCX, wiring and integration. Designer and template-flow skills apply; no-motion. Existing project CI owns the complete unit suite and focused browser scenario, with GRACE limited to scope and database recovery.

T-001.Title: kafedra-flow-intake and kafedra-design: visual fields and reviewable prefill

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Reuse monthly workspace, keep a live preview adjacent to fields and explicit department context. Source data and print overrides have clear separate labels; desktop and mobile expose the same workflow.

Verification.Command: Inspect existing implementation and document design decisions

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: No decorative animation; existing reduced-motion rules remain. Stable controls and visible loading/error states.

T-003.Title: kafedra-data: versioned fields and durable selection evidence

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Add schema 033 for template versions, canonical extra values, immutable selection runs and monthly references/overrides. Validate typed values, ownership, source ACL, revisions and idempotency.

Verification.Command: Focused template/fields/migration tests and database gate

T-004.Title: kafedra-feature: grounded department selection and DOCX

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Bounded LLM ranking with honest fallback; server-saved proposals are revalidated per source during acceptance. Visual template DOCX has exact columns, required-field errors and reproducible snapshot; existing samples remain supported.

T-005.Title: kafedra-feature: implement visual editor and review

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Configure fields, inspect preview, suggest, select, accept, edit and export. Preserve pending edits and make late replies harmless.

T-006.Title: kafedra-design-audit and kafedra-tests: independent integrated acceptance

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Independent source/ACL/UX review, desktop/mobile actual browser evidence, conflict/partial/retry checks and snapshot continuity.

Verification.Command: Final GRACE lint/scope and exact-head CI
